extracted.intended_audience: prospective and current researchers at King's College London (postgraduate applicants, doctoral candidates, postdoctoral and early career researchers) and UK academics seeking funding opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: University information page listing internal and external research funding opportunities, studenthips, scholarships, fellowships, and support resources at King's College London. Useful for researchers seeking funding schemes and institutional application support.

rubrics_metrics.name: King's funding priorities (strategic value)
rubrics_metrics.description: King's is committed to providing funding to support new partnerships, inspiring projects and research of strategic value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding is targeted at projects that develop partnerships and have strategic value to the university; emphasis on multi- and inter-disciplinary work and translation for impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postgraduate research studentships and scholarships (scope)
rubrics_metrics.description: We offer extensive postgraduate research studentships, scholarships and funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers a range of postgraduate funding mechanisms; prospective doctoral students should review specific schemes for eligibility and coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for post-doctoral and Early Career Researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: We have a vibrant community of post-doctoral and Early Career Researchers, and welcome outstanding applicants to external Fellowship schemes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information and support are available for postdocs and ECRs seeking internal funding or preparing applications to external fellowships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying for funding (application support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Support for researchers applying or negotiating for research funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutional support is provided during application and negotiation stages — researchers should consult the relevant support services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Doctoral Opportunities & Funding (centralised information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover Doctoral Opportunities & Funding at King's.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centralised listing for doctoral-level funding opportunities; a starting point for applicants to find available studentships and training centre information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding & Scholarships (postgraduate range)
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover our range of postgraduate research funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summary gateway to specific scholarship and funding schemes for postgraduate researchers; follow links to scheme details for eligibility, benefits and application procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Home Student Funding (residency-based funding opportunities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding opportunities for prospective doctoral students with Home Student...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates there are funding schemes targeted at students with 'Home' status — applicants should check residency/fee-status eligibility details on the specific pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: King’s Together Seed Fund (seed funding objective)
rubrics_metrics.description: King’s Together, which provides initial support to develop multi and inter-disciplinary projects into innovative, externally-funded research across strategic areas, and funds to accelerate the translation of our research for innovation and impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seed funding aimed at developing interdisciplinary projects toward external funding and accelerating translation/impact; projects should align with the university's strategic areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint A*STAR—King's College London PhD Studentships in Biomedical Science (fully funded studentships)
rubrics_metrics.description: Joint A*STAR—King's College London PhD Studentships in Biomedical Science — Fully funded awards; this includes tuition fees, stipend and bench fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies what 'fully funded' covers (tuition, stipend, bench fee); applicants should verify eligibility criteria and application process for the joint studentship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowships for Early Career Researchers (career-stage funding)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships for Early Career Researchers — Join a dynamic community of postdoctoral and early career researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellowship schemes are available for ECRs; details on eligibility, duration and application requirements are on linked pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Doctoral Training Centres & Partnerships (collaborative doctoral training)
rubrics_metrics.description: Doctoral Training Centres & Partnerships — King’s is part of many Doctoral Training Partnerships and Centres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates participation in larger DTP/DTC programmes — applicants should consult specific partnerships for cohort-based funding, training expectations, and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: International PhD Scholarships (support for international students)
rubrics_metrics.description: International PhD Scholarships — Funding opportunities for international postgraduate researchers at King's.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted scholarships for international applicants; check scheme pages for coverage, residency/fee implications, and application deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellcome Trust Biomedical Vacation Scholarships (short-term research experience)
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome Trust Biomedical Vacation Scholarships — Hands-on experience of research during the summer holidays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short-term, typically summer placements offering practical research experience; aimed at undergraduates/pre-doctoral candidates — review eligibility and application details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing research proposals (research development support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Further information and resources — Developing research proposals: Dedicated research development support for each of the academic Faculties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each faculty provides proposal development support; researchers should contact faculty development teams for help with proposal drafting, costing, and submission strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Professional (funding opportunity discovery tool)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Professional — Discover funding opportunities open to UK academics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External database/search tool to find UK funding opportunities; recommended for ongoing horizon-scanning of calls and eligibility filtering.
